title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. CHAIR SQUATS, STEP-UPS, REVERSE LUNGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH. WEIGH-IN DAY. NO HIDING.

script.welcome: MONDAY MORNING, YOU WEEKEND WARRIOR. LEGS AND LUNGS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. SQUATS, STEP UPS, LUNGES, A BALANCE TEST, THEN WE STRETCH THE HAMSTRINGS AND THE HIPS. AND IT IS WEIGH IN DAY, SO WHATEVER YOU ATE YESTERDAY, WE ARE WORKING IT OFF WITH DIGNITY. ON YOUR FEET. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. SHAKE THE LEGS OUT. NO, YOU MAY NOT SIT DOWN AND READ YOUR EMAIL.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT YOUR BEST. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LEGS WORKED, LUNGS OPEN, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS LOOSE. THAT IS HOW A MAN STILL CLIMBS HIS OWN STAIRS AT EIGHTY FIVE. NOW GO AND REPORT THAT WEIGHT, AND DO NOT LIE TO ME, I CAN SMELL FIBS FROM HERE.
script.pause: HOLD. DO NOT WANDER OFF TO THE BISCUIT TIN.

exercises.name: CHAIR SQUATS (TAP AND STAND)
exercises.cue: STAND IN FRONT OF A STURDY CHAIR, FEET SHOULDER-WIDTH. SIT THE HIPS BACK AND DOWN UNTIL YOUR BACKSIDE JUST TAPS THE SEAT, THEN DRIVE UP THROUGH THE HEELS. CHEST TALL, KNEES TRACK OVER TOES. DO NOT FLOP INTO THE CHAIR.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SQUATS. TWO ROUNDS. TEN REPS. SIT BACK, TAP THE SEAT, DRIVE UP THROUGH THE HEELS. TAP, I SAID. NOT SETTLE IN FOR A CUP OF TEA.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THEM OUT. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR, HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU WANT IT. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN SLOW. DO ALL EIGHT ON ONE LEG, THEN SWITCH. STEADY PACE, BREATHING HARDER IS THE POINT.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT EACH LEG. WHOLE FOOT ON. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. DOWN SLOW. THIS IS THE LUNGS PART, SO PUFF IF YOU MUST, BUT KEEP MOVING.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. HEART PUMPING. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, HAND ON A WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES ARE ROUGHLY NINETY DEGREES, BACK KNEE HOVERING. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. ALTERNATE LEGS. TORSO UPRIGHT, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. LOWER SLOW. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. HAND ON THE WALL IS LEGAL. FALLING OVER IS NOT.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, SOFT KNEE, FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR OR WALL IF NEEDED. HINGE AT THE HIP, CHEST FORWARD AND THE FREE LEG REACHING BACK, BACK FLAT. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU STAY STEADY, PAUSE, THEN STAND TALL. HIPS LEVEL.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. YOUR BALANCE TEST. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE. TIP FORWARD, LEG BACK, FLAT BACK. PAUSE. STAND TALL. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR IS FINE. WOBBLING IS HOW IT GETS BETTER, SO WOBBLE WITH PRIDE.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER THAN LAST WEEK. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE FIRST OR SECOND STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT NOT LOCKED, TOES UP. HAND ON THE RAIL. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A FLAT BACK UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. NO BOUNCING. HOLD THIRTY, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. HEEL ON THE STAIR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TOES UP. FLAT BACK. HINGE FORWARD. NO BOUNCING, YOU ARE NOT A BLOODY POGO STICK.

exercises.name: HALF-KNEELING HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, BACK KNEE ON A CUSHION, FRONT FOOT FLAT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, EASE THE HIPS FORWARD. REACH THE ARM ON THE KNEELING SIDE OVERHEAD. TALL CHEST. HOLD THIRTY, SWITCH. HAND ON A CHAIR IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. HALF KNEEL. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TUCK THE TAIL. SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE. EASE FORWARD. REACH UP TALL. UNDO ALL THAT SITTING, YOU DESK BOUND DORMOUSE.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. NOW GO AND STEP ON THAT SCALE.
